searchText: FYI Eth2 protocol upgrade naming theme brainstorming discussion: https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-pm/issues/202 welcome to use emojis to signal your opinions 🙂 I'm running Geth on a different machine and seeing the same bad voting that you are. I don't think it's related Over the last 30 days I've voted incorrectly: Head: 2.236% Target: 0.524% Source: 0.014% All machines are well resourced. I'm running a _decent_ amount of validators so shouldn't be too skewed by sample size 30 days averages are a little skewed, last 2 weeks have been way worse (quantitatively in my node and guessing on the number of complaints in prysm's discord). My 30 day average does go like yours, but I'm currently having 9-10 bad heads per validitor per day which is over 4% I'll check the last week 1 sec But in my case I'm only running 2 validators so I can be skewed by sample size 😆 In any case I think the correlation points not only about my own copy of geth, but also the block proposers It's clear to me now that eth1 activity is delaying blocks interesting, these stats are much worse Head: 3.424% Target: 0.598% Source: 0.037% I get why the head would be worse, but why would the source vote nearly triple? 🤔
